gloss: to wear; to put on; to have on

definitions.gloss: to wear; to put on; to have on
definitions.explanation: A formal term for wearing clothes or equipment on one's body. Used in official instructions, signs, regulations, and formal announcements rather than everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着用|ちゃくよう}する。
⟦ヘルメット→ヘルメット：11325_herumetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧づけられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安全靴|あんぜんぐつ}→安全靴：24184_anzengutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着用|ちゃくよう}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wear safety shoes inside the factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦シートベルト→シートベルト：29083_shiitoberuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着用|ちゃくよう}しない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{科|か}されます。
examples.english: If you don't wear a seatbelt, you will be fined.

notes:
More formal than ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ or ⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧. Primarily seen on signs, in regulations, and in official announcements. Became extremely common during the COVID-19 pandemic in the phrase ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧ (mask wearing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧: mask wearing
- ⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: obligation to wear
- ⟦ヘルメット→ヘルメット：11325_herumetto⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧: helmet wearing
- ⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: wearing rate
- ⟦{常時|じょうじ}→常時：19766_jouji⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧: wearing at all times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear (clothes) — everyday term for wearing clothing on the torso
- ⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧: to wear (on head) — everyday term for hats, helmets
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}ける→着く：00680_tsuku⟧: to wear, carry on one's person — includes accessories and items
